results.name: 01_todo
results.idea: A todo list app with user accounts. Users can register and log in. Each user sees only their own todos. Todos have a title, optional description, due date, priority (low/medium/high), and done/undone status. Users can create, edit, delete, and mark todos complete. Filter by status and priority.

results.name: 02_expense_tracker
results.idea: A personal expense tracker with user login. Users log expenses with amount, category (food/transport/utilities/entertainment/other), date, and notes. Dashboard shows total spent this month, breakdown by category with percentages, and a list of recent transactions. Users can edit and delete expenses. Monthly summary view.

results.name: 03_gym_tracker
results.idea: A gym workout tracker with user login. Users create workout plans containing exercises (name, sets, reps, weight in kg). They log completed workout sessions per plan. Each session records actual sets/reps/weight for each exercise. Progress view shows weight lifted over time per exercise. Users can create, edit, and delete plans and sessions.

results.name: 04_crm
results.idea: A simple CRM for small businesses with user login. Users manage contacts (name, email, phone, company, status: lead/prospect/customer/churned). Add notes to any contact with timestamps. Log interactions (call/email/meeting) with date and outcome. Pipeline view shows contacts grouped by status with counts. Search contacts by name or company.

results.name: 05_lms
results.idea: A learning management system with two roles: instructor and student. Instructors create courses with title, description, and lessons (title, content text, order). Students enroll in courses and mark lessons complete. Student dashboard shows enrolled courses and completion percentage per course. Instructors see enrollment counts per course.

results.name: 06_ecommerce
results.idea: An e-commerce store with admin and customer roles. Admins add products (name, description, price, stock quantity, category). Customers browse products, add to cart, and place orders. Order has status: pending/confirmed/shipped/delivered. Customers view order history with status. Admins view all orders and update their status. Stock decrements when order is placed.

results.name: 07_chat
results.idea: A real-time group chat application with user login. Users join named chat rooms. Messages appear instantly via WebSocket without page refresh. Each message shows sender name and timestamp. Users can see who else is currently in the room (online presence). Create new rooms, list available rooms, and leave rooms. Message history loads when joining a room.

results.name: 08_booking
results.idea: A service booking platform with provider and customer roles. Providers create services (name, description, duration in minutes, price). Providers set weekly availability (day of week, start time, end time). Customers browse services, see available time slots, and book appointments. Bookings have status: pending/confirmed/cancelled. Providers confirm or cancel bookings. Customers see upcoming bookings.

results.name: 09_blog
results.idea: A blog CMS with author and reader roles. Authors write posts with title, content (markdown), tags, and cover image URL. Posts can be saved as draft or published. Readers see all published posts, can filter by tag, and read individual posts. Authors manage their own posts (create, edit, delete, publish). Post list shows title, author, date, and tag list.

results.name: 10_portfolio
results.idea: A developer portfolio with an admin panel and a public-facing site. Admin adds projects (title, description, tech stack tags, GitHub URL, live URL, thumbnail URL, featured flag). Admin writes blog posts. Public site shows projects grid with filtering by tech tag, featured projects highlighted, and blog. Admin can reorder projects and toggle featured status. No login required for public view.

results.name: 11_ai_chatbot
results.idea: A customer support chatbot with user login. Users start chat sessions and ask questions. Each message goes to an OpenAI-compatible API (use OPENAI_API_KEY from env, model gpt-3.5-turbo). System prompt sets the assistant persona. Chat history is preserved per session. Users can start new sessions and view past sessions with their full message history. Admins can update the system prompt.

results.name: 12_dashboard
results.idea: An analytics dashboard for a SaaS business with user login. Dashboard shows: total users, active users this month, monthly revenue, churn rate. Charts show user signups per month (last 12 months) and revenue per month. Tables show top 10 active users and recent signups. Admin can add synthetic data records (user events with type and amount). All metrics recompute from the stored events.

results.name: 13_file_upload
results.idea: A document management system with user login. Users upload files (PDF, DOCX, images up to 10MB). Files are stored on disk under uploads/ with a UUID filename. Each file record stores original filename, mimetype, size in bytes, upload date, and uploader. Users see their own files in a list. They can download any file, rename it, or delete it. Admin sees all files from all users with uploader info.

results.name: 14_auth
results.idea: A complete authentication system. Users register with email and password (bcrypt hashed). Email verification: after signup, a verification token is generated and stored; user must click a verification link to activate account. Password reset: user requests reset by email, gets a token (stored in DB), clicks link to set new password. JWT access tokens expire in 15 minutes, refresh tokens in 7 days. Profile page shows account info.

results.name: 15_payment
results.idea: A subscription billing platform with mock payments (no real Stripe calls). Users choose a plan: Free ($0/month, 5 projects), Pro ($29/month, unlimited projects), Team ($99/month, 10 seats). "Payment" is simulated by storing a payment record with card_last4 (hardcoded mock) and setting subscription status to active. Users can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel. Cancel sets subscription to end at period end. Invoice history shows past payments.

results.name: 16_multiplayer_game
results.idea: A real-time multiplayer trivia game using WebSockets. Players join a game lobby with a username (no login required). Host starts the game. Each round: server sends a multiple-choice question to all players. Players have 10 seconds to answer. Server reveals the correct answer and updates the scoreboard. After 10 questions, game ends and shows final leaderboard. Host can start a new game. Support 2-8 players per lobby.

results.name: 17_admin_panel
results.idea: A multi-tenant SaaS admin panel with two roles: superadmin and user. Superadmin sees all users: email, signup date, plan, last active, banned status. Superadmin can ban/unban users, change their plan, and delete accounts. Users see their own profile and can edit display name and timezone. Audit log tracks all admin actions (who did what and when). Superadmin can export the user list as CSV. Paginated user table with search by email.

results.name: 18_inventory
results.idea: An inventory management system with user login. Users manage products (SKU, name, category, unit cost, selling price, current stock, reorder threshold). Add stock via purchase orders (supplier name, quantity, unit cost, date). Deduct stock via sales records (customer name, quantity, date). Dashboard shows low-stock alerts (items below reorder threshold), total inventory value, and recent movements. Search and filter products by category.

results.name: 19_hospital
results.idea: A hospital management system with three roles: admin, doctor, and patient. Admins register doctors and manage departments. Patients register and book appointments with available doctors. Doctors see their appointment schedule. Doctors write consultation notes per appointment (diagnosis, prescription, follow-up date). Patients view their appointment history and consultation notes. Appointment status: scheduled/completed/cancelled. Doctors mark appointments completed after writing notes.

results.name: 20_restaurant_pos
results.idea: A restaurant point-of-sale system with staff and manager roles. Managers create the menu: categories (starters/mains/desserts/drinks) and items (name, price, available toggle). Staff open tables, add items to the table's order, and mark items as served. Multiple items can be added in one order. Staff generate a bill (itemized total + tax at 10%). Manager sees daily sales report: total revenue, number of orders, top-selling items. Tables can be cleared after payment.
